catalogs.area: System UI: launcher/home, widgets page, Control Center, gestures + app switcher, home bar, status bar, rounded corners, boot animation, system popups, keyboard, volume indicator (HiBy dialog strip and ByOS pill), power/brightness/auto-lock, Memory page

screens.name: Boot animation (hibyboot)
screens.how_to_reach: Power the player off (long power key) and on. hibyboot loops the HBA1 animation while hibymod_disp holds the player (BOOT_HOLD_S 30); hibyshell writes /tmp/hibyos_boot_stop and sends 'R'.
controls: none (passive)

screens.name: Home screen / launcher (page 1, default 56px icons, 4 columns)
screens.how_to_reach: Boot, or the home gesture from any app. The shell captures the stock home and covers it (launcher_on).
controls: Grid icons, cell origin x=25/96/167/238, y=46/137/228, so centres are (53,74) Settings, (124,74) Wireless, (195,74) Files, (266,74) Radio, (53,165) Apps, (124,165) Tidal, (195,165) Qobuz, (266,165) Gutenberg, (53,256) Vinyl
Dock (y 378-462): (52,420) Books, (124,420) Headphones, (196,420) Now Playing, (268,420) Music
Page dots at y=365 (only when there are 2 or more pages)
Music chevron sprite at y=468 (while music plays and Chevron is on)
Long-press an icon (450 ms) and release: action sheet with Open / Edit Home Screen / Uninstall (removable apps only)
Long-press empty space (550 ms): edit mode
Swipe right on page 1: widgets page
Top band y<48: left half opens Control Center, right half opens the player
Bottom band y>=456 swiped up: home switcher (default)
Toast at y 40-76

screens.name: Home edit mode (jiggle)
screens.how_to_reach: Long-press empty space, or the action sheet's 'Edit Home Screen', or long-press an icon and move it.
controls: Settings pill: x 12-104, y 34-64 (tap at (50,49), touch zone x<110)
Done pill: x 238-308, y 34-64 (tap at (275,49), touch zone x>230)
Icons shifted down 22 px and rotating ±1.5 px
Drag an icon onto a slot, the dock (y>=372) or a page edge (x<26 or x>294 for 480 ms turns the page)
Tap empty space to leave edit mode

screens.name: Widgets page
screens.how_to_reach: Swipe right on home page 1 (only when Settings › Home › Widgets page is on).
controls: Default layout (WG_TOP 44): Battery S (16,44) 137x137, Date S (167,44), Now Playing M (16,195) 288x137, Recent M (16,346), Listening M (16,497), Clock S, Mixes S, Library S, Storage S below (needs scrolling)
Now Playing M buttons (no scroll): prev (175,310), play/pause (221,310), next (267,310), hit radius 22
Tap a widget to open its app (NP to Now Playing, Storage to Files, Library/Recent/Listening/Mixes to Music, Battery to Headphones or Settings › Battery, Power to Settings › Power)

'Edit' button centred under the last widget
Vertical scroll with inertia; swipe left returns to home

screens.name: Widgets edit mode and gallery

Done pill at the right (touch zone x>210, y 28-70)
'−' badge at each widget's top-left corner + (9,9), radius 20
Hold a widget 350 ms then drag to reorder; dragging near y>436 or y<84 auto-scrolls
Swipe up from y>=452: leave edit mode
Gallery: list, detail with preview, size control at y 346, Add button at y 390

screens.name: Control Center (ByOS, iOS 26)
screens.how_to_reach: Swipe down from y<48 on the left half (default G.top=CC) on home, on a HiBy screen, or inside a ByOS app; or swipe right on Now Playing.
controls: Now Playing module x 14-154, y 68-208: play/pause hit x>82 and y<140 (glyph at (115,106)); prev x<84 and y>164 (glyph (49,186)); next x>=84 and y>164 (glyph (119,186)); elsewhere opens Now Playing

USB only (198,252), Power mode (274,252), USB DAC (46,328), Wi-Fi (122,328), DAC filter (198,328), Files (274,328), Settings (46,404)

Caption pill at y 36-60, shown for 1.8 s
Home bar drawn at y 469; swipe up anywhere: home; tap outside the controls: close; swipe left: player

screens.name: App switcher (multitasking)
screens.how_to_reach: In an app: swipe up from y>=456 and hold still for more than 300 ms (SW_HOLD_MS). On home: swipe up from y>=456 (G.bottom_home = GA_HOME).

Swipe sideways between cards

Drag a card down more than 49 px: open it
Tap a card: open it with a zoom

Release when not armed: the bubble retracts and nothing happens

'Free memory now' action

test_cases.title: Volume above the recommended level on a HiBy screen: the warning dialog appears once and OK works
preconditions: Headphones in the 3.5 mm jack; volume 30
A HiBy screen in front (for example HiBy's own settings list reached through a stock page), not a ByOS app
steps: start a frame recording (hibyctl rec) for 8 s
tap OK at the coordinates shown in the screenshot
expected: Frame by frame: the volume bar at (10,30) moves at 31 to 34, then the vol_ask dialog appears and stays still in every frame (no alternation between the dialog and the screen without it)
The OK tap reaches the player: the dialog closes within 1 frame of the release and the volume goes above 34
No home-bar blink, no full-screen redraw flashes
hibyshell keeps running (pid unchanged)
test_cases.known_bug: User: when the over-limit warning appears the screen flickers like crazy and OK cannot be pressed

test_cases.title: Volume warning while the ByOS home is in front (both indicator modes)
preconditions: ByOS home page 1 in front; run once with vol_ui 0 and once with vol_ui 1
expected: The dialog is visible and still. The launcher must not alternate with HiBy's frame: shell.log must not alternate 'el reproductor cambio de pantalla' / 'launcher fuera' and 'launcher activo'
The OK tap goes to the player (it is not taken by launcher_touch and does not open an app under it)
After OK the ByOS home comes back with no stock-home flash
test_cases.known_bug: Possible launcher enter/leave loop: the dialog may not cover the 8 home signature points, so the frame substitution keeps painting the launcher over it

test_cases.title: Volume warning while a ByOS app is open (Settings, Files, Music)
steps: try tapping where HiBy's OK button would be
expected: The user must see the warning (or ByOS must show its own equivalent) and be able to confirm it
The volume must not silently stay stuck at 34 while the player waits invisibly for OK
The app's frame must not flicker between the version with the volume strip and the version without it
test_cases.known_bug: Code: inside an app only the 300x38 volume strip is copied from fr1 (vs_overlay); HiBy's modal vol_ask dialog is never shown and touches go to the ByOS app, so OK cannot be pressed

test_cases.title: Volume warning while the Control Center is open
expected: The dialog or its ByOS equivalent is visible; the CC does not freeze
Closing the CC shows the warning screen without a flash, and the dialog can be confirmed

test_cases.title: HiBy volume bar (vol_ui 0) on home, widgets, a ByOS app, the CC, Now Playing and a HiBy screen
steps: On each screen: key:106,event3 then key:105,event3, 250 ms apart
expected: The bar appears at (10,30)-(310,68) with its rounded 19 px edge on every ByOS screen, matches the level, and disappears 0.6 s after the last key
Frame by frame there is no 1-frame blink of the bar and no strip of a different home (the stale launcher rows must not be painted over an app: hud_main guard)
No other rows change

test_cases.title: ByOS volume pill (vol_ui 1) full test: appear, follow, widen, fade, clamp
preconditions: Settings › Sound › Volume Indicator = ByOS; home in front; volume 10
steps: key:106,event3 ten times at 120 ms intervals
raise to the maximum with 60 keys; then lower to 0 with 60 keys
expected: The pill is at x 289-317, y 113-273; it fades in over 220 ms, its width eases from 12 to 17 px with a 260 ms bump on each key, and the white fill tracks vol_now/vol_max with no overshoot (tau 45 ms) and never runs ahead of the real value
The speaker glyph is inside the pill at its bottom; the wave disappears at level 0
Fade-out starts 1.4 s after the last key and lasts 300 ms
At 100 and at 0 the fill is full and empty with no oscillation
No home-bar or status-bar blink between pill frames
test_cases.known_bug: User asked to test the ByOS pill completely

test_cases.title: ByOS pill over a HiBy screen (capture mode) and the home bar
preconditions: vol_ui 1; a HiBy screen with the home bar overlay visible (y 469)
expected: The home bar stays visible in every frame while the pill is shown
When the pill ends, release ('R') shows HiBy's live frame with no step back to an old frame
test_cases.known_bug: Code: hud_frame clears ov_cur before capturing, so the home-bar blend in hud_compose_present never runs; the bar disappears during the pill and comes back afterwards

test_cases.title: Volume keys during animations (app zoom, CC open, switcher, keyboard slide, Now Playing sheet)
steps: tap:53,74 and send key:106,event3 at +50 ms and +150 ms during the 320 ms zoom
swipe:160,472,160,330,300,700 (switcher hold) with key:105 while held
open a keyboard (Files › New folder) and press key:106 during its slide-in
expected: The animation keeps its frame rate (no frame over 2 panel periods, about 45 ms)
The indicator is drawn on top of the animation frames without tearing; no frame shows the indicator without the animation or the reverse
The volume changes exactly once per key

test_cases.title: Rapid volume keys on a HiBy screen with the ByOS pill: no per-frame 300 KB alloc/free churn
steps: read shell.log perf lines and /proc/<shell>/status VmRSS before and after
expected: Pill frames are steady (no jank)
Shell RSS returns to its baseline
No 'memoria' trim storm in the log
test_cases.known_bug: Code: the main loop calls lazy_release() on every idle iteration even while hud_active (poll timeout 0), so hud_tmp (300 KB) is freed and malloc'd again for every pill frame

test_cases.title: Switching the volume indicator between HiBy and ByOS
steps: Set Volume Indicator = ByOS; leave Settings; key:106,event3; shot
Set Volume Indicator = HiBy; key:106,event3; shot
expected: ByOS: HiBy's volume.dlg is hidden (no grey bar) and the pill shows
HiBy: the bar shows again
The choice survives a reboot (launcher.conf volui)

test_cases.title: Pill in Now Playing (no status bar, so no OCR and no vol_now)
preconditions: vol_ui 1; HiBy Now Playing (or own player) in front
steps: key:106,event3 five times; key:105,event3 five times
expected: The pill moves one step per key and ends where it started

test_cases.title: CC music module: play/pause switches the icon, without flicker, playing and paused
preconditions: A track playing; home in front; test once over wired and once over Bluetooth output
expected: Frame by frame: on press only a light circle (radius 21) appears behind the button; the whole module must NOT flash brighter and then dim
The glyph changes from pause bars to the play triangle within 500 ms of the audio stopping, and back
Audio really pauses and resumes; status-bar play glyph (x 60) matches
No other part of the CC repaints; the CC stays open
test_cases.known_bug: User: the CC music widget stops the music but flickers, breaks the interface and does not switch between pause and play. Code: the module highlight (pressed 100) is painted on touch-down and then removed; the state is read only 350 ms after the key, while 'playing' needs up to 1.5 s to fall (pcm_last_ms), and the CC overwrites npx with that stale state

test_cases.title: CC music module previous/next
preconditions: A queue of 3 or more tracks playing
expected: A pressed circle (radius 18) flashes on the button only
Title, artist and cover update to the new track within about 1.5 s with no whole-panel blink
Audio: no gap longer than a normal track change

test_cases.title: CC play/pause opened from home must not throw the screen to a HiBy page
expected: After closing, the ByOS home is in front (not HiBy's Now Playing or home)
shell.log has no 'el reproductor cambio de pantalla' right after the KEY_PLAYPAUSE
test_cases.known_bug: User: 'breaks the interface'; the injected KEY_PLAYPAUSE may make HiBy change page under the launcher

test_cases.title: CC music module: nothing loaded, paused, playing, queue finished
preconditions: Fresh boot with nothing played, then the other states
steps: open the CC in each state; shot
expected: Nothing loaded: Now Playing icon placeholder, 'Reproduciendo'/'Now Playing', 'En pausa'
Queue finished: play replays the last track (pc_toggle_or_replay)
The text never overflows its 116 px width

test_cases.title: Tap the music module body: the player opens
preconditions: Music playing; run from home, from a ByOS app and from a HiBy screen
expected: The CC fades (180 ms) and the ByOS Now Playing opens; closing it returns to the original screen

test_cases.title: Open the CC following the finger; cancel a short pull
expected: Full: the blur grows in proportion, controls slide down 28 px and fade in, the status bar stays still, 200 ms settle
Short slow: it animates back to closed in 160 ms
Short fast: it opens
No frame shows a band of a different darkness at rows 0-30

test_cases.title: Open the CC inside every ByOS app and over HiBy screens
steps: For Settings, Wireless, Files, Radio, Apps, Gutenberg, Vinyl, Books, Headphones, Music, Now Playing, Tidal (HiBy), a HiBy settings page: swipe:80,36,80,330,300; shot; tap outside to close; shot
expected: The CC opens over a blurred copy of the exact current screen and closes back to the same app state (the scroll position and keyboard are unchanged)
The home bar slides out while the CC is open and comes back afterwards
The app is not restarted; inside Now Playing (top_gesture_off) the top gesture does nothing
test_cases.known_bug: User: most apps glitch at some point

test_cases.title: Close the CC: tap outside, swipe up to home, small swipe-up cancel
preconditions: CC open from a HiBy screen, from home and from a ByOS app
expected: Tap outside: fades to the original screen in 200 ms
Swipe up: controls rise and fade and the real home appears (from inside an app the app stays: cc_in_app restores the app)
Small slow swipe: the panel springs back in 160 ms

test_cases.title: Brightness slider: 1:1 drag, growth, rubber band, Power Saving cap
steps: set Power Saving (tile 274,252) and drag to the top again
expected: The fill follows the finger 1:1; the real backlight changes in the same frame; the module grows to 1.04 and springs back over 220 ms; the sun grows with the level
Past the ends it stretches by at most 10 px; the tip is never clipped
The minimum backlight is 2 (never black)
Power Saving: the fill stops at 40/101
Only rows 44-238 repaint (partial present)

test_cases.title: Hold the brightness slider: Display & Brightness opens
preconditions: CC open from home, then from inside a ByOS app
expected: From home: the CC fades and Settings opens on Display & Brightness
Inside an app: no navigation (the hold is ignored) and the CC stays usable

test_cases.title: CC Bluetooth circle toggles HiBy Bluetooth; caption and status bar agree
steps: wait 3; shot; check the status bar at x 200-210
tap:46,252 twice quickly (the second while busy)
expected: The circle turns blue at once; caption 'Bluetooth activado'; after the setting thread finishes the state is real (hs_get)
Tapping while busy must not show a caption that contradicts the circle
test_cases.known_bug: Code: cc_bt_toggle returns the inverted value while ccbt_busy, and the caption uses it

test_cases.title: CC Bluetooth module reflects changes made in Wireless or Settings
preconditions: Open the CC once (ccbt_on read and cached)
steps: close the CC; open Wireless (tap:124,74) and switch Bluetooth OFF there
go home; open the CC; shot
expected: The circle is grey and the module says 'Desactivado'
test_cases.known_bug: Code: ccbt_on is cached on first read and never refreshed after wl_hs_set from Wireless or Settings; only ccair updates it

test_cases.title: BT module with headphones connected: name, battery, glyph; tap opens Headphones
preconditions: Headphones paired and connected (via ByOS Wireless)

The tap opens the Headphones app (from inside an app: the current app closes first)
Status bar shows the BT rune at x 200-210 and the BT output pill
test_cases.known_bug: User: Bluetooth headphones never appear or pair; BT icon missing in the status bar

test_cases.title: Airplane Mode on/off restores only what was on; ADB-over-Wi-Fi confirmation
steps: open the CC; tap:274,100; wait 3; shot
enable ADB over Wi-Fi, then tap:274,100
expected: On: the tile turns orange, caption 'Modo avión activado', Wi-Fi icon disappears from the status bar
Off: Wi-Fi comes back on, Bluetooth stays off
With ADB over Wi-Fi: a confirmation sheet first; Cancel leaves everything as it was and shows no caption
Tapping again while busy shows 'Espera a que termine la operación'

test_cases.title: Noise Control tile: no headphones, connecting, unsupported, cycle modes

Filter: cycles through 8 (or 2) filters with their names

test_cases.title: Long-press every CC tile opens its Settings page
steps: hold:274,100,800 → Wireless; hold:274,176,800 → Headphones; hold:46,252,800 → Wireless; hold:198,252,800 → Power; hold:274,252,800 → Power; hold:46,328,800 → USB; hold:122,328,800 → Wireless; hold:198,328,800 → Sound; hold:274,328,800 → Files; hold:46,404,800 → Control Center page
expected: Each opens the mapped page; the tile's own action does NOT also run
The pressed highlight shows during the hold

test_cases.title: From the CC inside a ByOS app, open another app (Files, Settings, Wireless)

No double zoom, no blank frame, Radio's audio is not interrupted

test_cases.title: CC ↔ player horizontal paging and swipe up to home from either

on Now Playing swipe:20,250,300,250,300 (back to the CC)

test_cases.title: Settings › Control Center: remove, reorder and add tiles

expected: The layout re-flows: two non-wide tiles in the right column, the BT module never splits across rows

test_cases.title: CC status bar and caption timeout
expected: A sharp status bar over the blur

test_cases.title: Open and close ByOS apps from icons (zoom)

test_cases.title: Open Tidal/Qobuz (HiBy apps) and go back

test_cases.title: Long-press an icon: action sheet (Open, Edit Home Screen, Uninstall)

expected: The icon un-presses at 450 ms; on release the sheet appears; Uninstall only for removable apps, in red
Uninstall removes it from the home and from launcher.conf ('removed'), with no empty page left

test_cases.title: Edit mode: enter, jiggle, Done, Settings pill, tap empty

expected: Icons shift 22 px down and jiggle ±1.5° desynchronised, at a steady frame rate; pills fade in

test_cases.title: Drag an icon to another slot, into and out of the dock, onto a new page

test_cases.title: Music chevron on home appears/disappears with music

test_cases.title: Settings › Home: icon size, columns, labels, dots, dock background, dim wallpaper

expected: The grid re-flows with no lost apps (home_reflow); labels fit their cells

A blurred status bar with no seam

tap:267,310; wait 2; shot; tap:175,310; wait 2; shot
expected: A light circle on the pressed button only; the play/pause glyph flips at once (optimistic for 2.5 s) and then matches the real state

test_cases.title: Tap each widget opens the right app and the home returns to widgets afterwards

code_evident_bugs.title: HiBy's volume warning (vol_ask) is invisible and cannot be confirmed while a ByOS app is open
code_evident_bugs.evidence: In capture mode the shell only copies HiBy's 300x38 volume strip from fr1 (vs_visible/vs_overlay, src/hibyshell.c:1015-1035; hud_compose_present 1062-1077). The modal vol_ask dialog in fr1 is never shown, and touches go to the ByOS app (read_pkt), so OK cannot be pressed and the volume stays stuck at warn_vol.

code_evident_bugs.title: CC music module flickers and its play/pause icon stays stale
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/cc.inc.c:687 repaints the whole module highlighted (pressed 100, alpha 80 at line 206) on touch-down; 722 removes it; 726 repaints again. The state is read 350 ms after the key (724-725), but 'playing' only falls 1.5 s after the last PCM write (src/nowplaying.inc.c:373). The CC also writes that stale state into npx (725), so the update waits for npx_thread (src/nowplay.inc.c:17-28) and a CC idle tick.

code_evident_bugs.title: System popup (headphones card) is not animated or closed on idle screens
code_evident_bugs.evidence: syspop_tick is called only from read_pkt (src/hibyshell.c:631). The main loop calls read_pkt only when a touch arrives (1887-1889), so on an idle home or HiBy screen the card does not start, and once shown it freezes and never auto-closes until touched. The main loop also lazy_release()s sp_tmp/sp_base while sp_on (1887 with syspop.inc.c:61-62).

code_evident_bugs.title: 300 KB alloc/free on every volume-pill frame
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/hibyshell.c:1887 calls lazy_release() on every idle loop iteration, including when hud_active (poll timeout 0 at 1836). hud_compose_present then re-allocates hud_tmp (1064) for every frame on HiBy screens and in apps: mmap/munmap churn and page faults during the animation.

code_evident_bugs.title: Home bar disappears during the ByOS pill on HiBy screens
code_evident_bugs.evidence: hud_frame sets ov_cur = 0 before capturing (src/hibyshell.c:1086), so the branch that blends spr_bar when ov_cur == &spr_bar (1071) never runs. The bar vanishes while the pill is shown and comes back on update_overlay.

code_evident_bugs.title: CC Bluetooth state is cached and goes stale
code_evident_bugs.evidence: ccbt_on is read once from user.ini (src/ccbt.inc.c:17-21) and only updated by the CC itself and ccair (src/ccair.inc.c:43,69,72,80). Toggling Bluetooth in Wireless (wl_hs_set, src/wireless.inc.c:582) or in Settings › Bluetooth never updates it, so the CC module shows the wrong state.

code_evident_bugs.title: Bluetooth toggle caption is wrong while a change is pending
code_evident_bugs.evidence: cc_bt_toggle returns 'on ? 0 : 1' when ccbt_busy (src/ccbt.inc.c:25); cc.inc.c:738-740 uses the return value for the caption, so it announces the opposite of the current state.

code_evident_bugs.title: 'Free memory now' trims canvases while an app is running
code_evident_bugs.evidence: mm_free_now calls mem_trim() from inside Settings (src/sysset.inc.c:797). mem_trim runs lazy_release and drop_pages on img_under, img_sheet and img_cache_plane plus shell_trim_extra (src/hibyshell.c:1673-1682), although the design says canvases must only be returned at rest (src/hibyshell.c:1626-1628).

code_evident_bugs.title: Possible launcher enter/leave loop under HiBy dialogs on home
code_evident_bugs.evidence: The library substitutes the launcher image whenever the 8 signature points match (src/hibymod_disp.c:150-178; points from src/launcher.inc.c:165-180: icon tops and two background pixels). A centred dialog that does not cover them is overwritten by the launcher. If it covers or dims them, the shell leaves (src/hibyshell.c:1848) and re-enters on home_hits (1854-1857), which can alternate frames (flicker).

code_evident_bugs.title: Status bar fixes edit HiBy's buffers with fragile deduplication
code_evident_bugs.evidence: Outside capture, sb_fix shifts the '%' block inside HiBy's own back buffer (src/hibymod_disp.c:951) and remembers only 8 hashes (244, 268). With partial redraws a shift can be repeated or mixed. In capture, the restore (966-969) puts back the fr1 copy, which already has sb_fix/sb_bolt applied, and only restores the '%' block. This is a candidate cause of the broken or growing status icons the user reports.

code_evident_bugs.title: Status-bar Bluetooth icon depends only on HiBy's own Bluetooth state
code_evident_bugs.evidence: The rune is HiBy's topbar_iv_bt image; 'bluetooth_unconnect' is blank (theme/topbar.py:247). Connections made by ByOS's BlueZ / hibybudsd path are invisible unless HiBy's player also reports BT connected, so the icon never appears.

code_evident_bugs.title: Shell is killed after a 10 s stall (abrupt closes)
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/hibymod_disp.c:620-633 SIGKILLs the shell when shell_beat stops for 10 s. Blocking work on the shell thread that does not beat (PNG encode in mirror_save, src/launcher.inc.c:877-917; /proc scans in mm_read, src/sysset.inc.c:758-781; music_session /proc fd walk, src/hibyshell.c:861-895) under low memory can reach this. The user sees an app close and the screen jump to HiBy.

code_evident_bugs.title: Critical-memory watcher kills the cover/tag helper
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/hibyshell.c:1646-1648 SIGKILLs hibytag, hibywall, hibymix and hibynet (unless the radio is active) below 4.5 MB. This can explain 'covers often not found'; retrying with new search text cannot help while the helper is dead.

code_evident_bugs.title: Guard band delays taps on HiBy screens
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/gestures.inc.c:654-681: on HiBy screens, touches at y 48-100 and x 72-248 count as zone 3 and are held up to 450 ms before being forwarded, so buttons there feel laggy or miss short taps.

code_evident_bugs.title: Home bar can stay hidden after an own-app home gesture
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/nowui.inc.c:1511 sets hb_after = now + 1e9 when the gesture returns 1. If the app does not actually exit, the bar never comes back until the next launch_app resets hb_after (src/launcher_touch.inc.c:202).

catalogs.notes:
The analysis was read-only: no device access, no adb, no repository changes. Default-layout coordinates come from launcher.inc.c (icon 56, 4 columns: cells x=25/96/167/238, y=46/137/228; dock icons at x=24/96/168/240, y=392), cc.inc.c (CC_M 14, CC_T 64, CC_G 12, CC_Y 68), widgets.inc.c (WG_M 16, WG_G 14, WG_TOP 44, padding 14) and theme/topbar.py (status bar x positions). They change if the user altered icon size, columns, CC tiles or widget order.

tools/hiby.py passes extra swipe arguments through to hibyctl. 'swipe:x1,y1,x2,y2,ms,hold' holds at the end, which is what the switcher needs. hiby.py has no 'drag': call 'hibyctl drag X1 Y1 X2 Y2 WAIT MOVE' directly for home edit drags. hiby.py also sleeps 1.2 s after every action, so frame-by-frame checks need hibyctl rec/fbrec (or an external camera for the boot) running in parallel.

The position of the HiBy vol_ask OK button is not in ByOS code; take it from a screenshot. Several user-reported bugs belong mainly to other areas: Bluetooth pairing (wireless/buds), audiobook playback (books_ab) and covers (lyrics/hibytag). Only their System UI symptoms are covered here.

Respect the memory note: never launch the browser (NetSurf) during these tests.

code_evident_bugs.title: The pill's HiBy-screen capture (hud_cap) clashes with other captures: CC, sheet and player gestures get overwritten or released
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/hibyshell.c:1079-1094 hud_frame keeps composing fr1 whenever hud_cap=1, and hud_end (1097) sends 'R' unconditionally. cc_prepare (src/cc.inc.c:480-488), player_from_edge (src/gestures.inc.c:72-77) and sheet_open_drag (src/hibyshell.c:477-480) all reuse the existing capture without clearing hud_cap. Result: HiBy frames alternate with CC frames, and the CC loses capture in the middle of its session.

code_evident_bugs.title: No handling of the EU high-volume dialog (vol_ask / volume_long_time_high)
code_evident_bugs.evidence: No source file mentions it (grep). docs/research_settings_api.md:64 confirms the key path shows it. On ByOS screens it is drawn only into fr1 (src/hibymod_disp.c:937-947). Touches go to the ByOS UI, so OK cannot be reached, and on the home the leave/enter decision (src/hibyshell.c:1848) depends on whether the dialog covers the signature points. Matches the user report of crazy flicker and OK not pressable.

code_evident_bugs.title: Home bar disappears on HiBy screens while the pill shows
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/hibyshell.c:1084 sets ov_cur = 0 before hud_compose_present checks ov_cur == &spr_bar (line 1071), so the bar is never drawn in pill frames. It comes back through update_overlay at the end (1170-1171), so it blinks.

code_evident_bugs.title: HiBy screen freezes during a finger drag while the pill is active
code_evident_bugs.evidence: read_pkt only steps the HUD when idle (src/hibyshell.c:629, r==0). The main loop forwards drags in while(cur_down && read_pkt) fwd() (src/hibyshell.c:1925). Meanwhile the panel stays on the last captured composite.

code_evident_bugs.title: hud_tmp (300 KB) is freed and re-allocated on every frame while the pill is on a HiBy screen
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/hibyshell.c:1887 calls lazy_release() on every idle iteration of the main loop, even while hud_active (the main loop polls with timeout 0, line 1836). hud_compose_present then calls lazy_alloc again (line 1064).

code_evident_bugs.title: The pill is double-blended on frames that come from launcher_present()
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/launcher.inc.c:790 blends the pill into fr0. present() then calls hud_after_present (src/hibyshell.c:191, 1107-1113), which blends it again into hud_tmp. Frames from launcher_present_hud blend it only once (hud_in=1), so the pill's opacity alternates. This happens on the widgets page, with toasts and in edit mode.

code_evident_bugs.title: The syspop card and the pill overwrite each other in the shared frame
code_evident_bugs.evidence: present() runs syspop_after_present and then hud_after_present (src/hibyshell.c:190-191). Each one copies fr0 plus only its own layer into fr0_shm (src/syspop.inc.c:34-43, src/hibyshell.c:1062-1077). syspop_tick presents without the pill and skips statusbar_tint/homebar_layer.

code_evident_bugs.title: The launcher can leave because of HiBy's own volume dialog (it shows the page-0 mirror and resets the widgets page)
code_evident_bugs.evidence: Leave condition at src/hibyshell.c:1848 is !is_home(fr1) && !vs_visible(). The home signature point (40,60) in shell/home.sig sits inside the dialog band (y30-68). vs_visible samples only 3 pixels (src/hibyshell.c:1015-1018). launcher_leave resets widgets_on/V.scroll (src/launcher.inc.c:866-875).

code_evident_bugs.title: fr1 is read without a sequence lock (torn band in HiBy-indicator mode)
code_evident_bugs.evidence: The library writes frames[1] under its own mutex (src/hibymod_disp.c:940). The shell reads fr1 in vs_visible/vs_overlay (src/hibyshell.c:1015-1029) and in launcher checks with no seqlock. A dialog-to-home transition can be copied half-and-half, which shows as a strip of home icons in the band.

code_evident_bugs.title: Capture mode with same-buffer pans lets the player's pixels reach the panel for one frame
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/hibymod_disp.c:936-946: when the player pans the already-visible buffer (same_pans++), it has already drawn into the scanned buffer before the shell image is copied back. This matches the README.md:641 known issue: a home strip over an app at some volumes. The hud_key log of same_pans (src/hibyshell.c:1138) shows this is being investigated.

code_evident_bugs.title: Switching the indicator back to HiBy removes every "visible":"hide" line in volume.dlg; ByOS mode hides only imageview/progress_bar elements
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/hibyshell.c:1046-1050: hide lines are dropped whenever vol_ui==0, including any that were in the original theme. is_last matches only "imageview":true / "progress_bar":true, so text labels would stay visible in ByOS mode.

code_evident_bugs.title: cfg_set can write a truncated override config.json
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/settings_app.inc.c:680-691 reads at most 8191 bytes from /usr/resource/config.json and writes exactly that to the override that hiby_player mounts at boot. A larger file would become invalid JSON after the reboot. au_reboot is also set even when the value goes back to the original.

code_evident_bugs.title: Fallback volume step assumes a 100-step scale
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/hibyshell.c:1137: vol_guess += ±1 (percent) when vol_now is unknown and no status bar is readable. On the 50-step scale the pill moves at half speed until vol_now arrives.

code_evident_bugs.title: HiBy-indicator tracking can busy-poll for up to 6 s
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/hibyshell.c:1164 keeps hud_active while any dialog with the same grey covers the 3 sample points (up to 6 s), and the main loop polls with timeout 0 while hud_active (line 1836). Guard ticks are skipped meanwhile (line 1887).

code_evident_bugs.title: Every partial present becomes a full-screen copy while the pill is visible
code_evident_bugs.evidence: In present(), hud_after_present copies the full frame and sets dirty to 0..H (src/hibyshell.c:1062-1077). This defeats present_rows in the CC brightness slider, the keyboard and the widgets, so performance drops while the pill shows.

catalogs.notes:
Read-only analysis; nothing was run on the device and no repository file was changed.

Coordinates:
- Pill sprite: HUD_X=289, HUD_Y=113, 28x160 (src/hibyshell.c:900-904). The visible pill is at x~297-314, y118-268. Fill top = 268 - 150*level.
- HiBy band: x10-310, y30-68.
- Status bar volume digits: x143-172, y4-25.
- Settings root 'Sound' row: y368-412 (tap:160,390). Rows are 44 px tall and start at y=120 (NAVH 64 + 30 + 12 + 14).
- Choice page: HiBy at tap:160,142, ByOS at tap:160,186. Back: tap:40,70.
- ss_alert button positions are estimates (the card height depends on how the text wraps). Confirm them with a shot.
- The EU dialog layout is not in the repo, so its OK/Cancel positions have to be taken from a screenshot.

Running the tests:
- tools/hiby.py 'key' sleeps 1.2 s after each key. For fast-turn and burst cases, send keys from one adb shell loop. For autorepeat, use the physical wheel or inject EV_KEY value 1, hold, then value 0.
- Frame-by-frame checks need a 240 fps video plus the shell log with /tmp/hibymod/perf present ('hud:' lines show v, raw, level, cap, main).
- Memory rule: never use the Navegador/NetSurf browser for external-app volume tests. External (present_direct) apps get no pill at all (present() returns early), so that path was left out.

code_evident_bugs.title: Home gesture from the search keyboard after re-focusing the field leaves Music running over the home screen
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/music.inc.c:1785 handles only r==-1 and r>0 from mu_search_edit; r==-3 (own_home_gesture already showed home, hb_after set to +1e9 in nowui.inc.c:1511) falls to mu_present(), so Music redraws on top and the home bar stays hidden. The first-entry path at music.inc.c:1737 handles -3 correctly.

code_evident_bugs.title: Mini player play/pause icon bounces back and forth
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/music.inc.c:1718 flips mu_np.playing optimistically without npx_changed or a hold; mu_poll (music.inc.c:1596-1606) replaces mu_np with the npx snapshot every 1 s, and the nowplay thread refreshes only every 1000 ms (nowplay.inc.c:8-31). The icon can revert to the old state and then flip again. nowui has a 2.5 s hold for this (nowui.inc.c:804-806) but the mini player does not. CC has the same pattern (cc.inc.c:724).

code_evident_bugs.title: Cover search shows and saves stale covers from a previous search
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/lyrics.inc.c:117 checks `run_capture(...) < 0`, but run_capture (tageditor.inc.c:31-45) returns the byte count (>=0) even when hibynet cover-get exits with an error. The code then reads NETDIR/c<i>.thumb.raw, and 'Usar esta carátula' saves NETDIR/c<i>.jpg. These files can be left over from an earlier search, so a different search text shows and saves the old album's cover.

code_evident_bugs.title: Covers are never found when the artist is empty, differs, or is 'Various Artists'
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/hibynet.c:870 sets g_art_miss=1 when the wanted artist is empty or does not match, and cmd_covers drops every such iTunes result (hibynet.c:925). The MusicBrainz query always contains artist:"<artist>" (hibynet.c:934). Clearing the artist in the manual search, or searching a compilation, returns nothing.

code_evident_bugs.title: Cover search reports 'no covers found' when there is no network
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/lyrics.inc.c:101 returns 0 on any failure and does not check hibynet's exit code, and cover_render always shows 'No se encontraron carátulas…' (lyrics.inc.c:135). The lyrics flow does tell network errors apart (lc_rc==2).

code_evident_bugs.title: Cover grid third row overlaps the 'Elegir imagen de la tarjeta SD' button
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/lyrics.inc.c:128 places rows at y=128/250/372 with 96 px thumbnails (to 468), while the button is drawn at H-52..H-12 (lyrics.inc.c:136) over them. Taps at y>=H-56 open the picker (lyrics.inc.c:193), and row-3 captions at y+111 (~483) are off-screen.

code_evident_bugs.title: Manual cover search keeps the edited artist when the album editor is cancelled
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/lyrics.inc.c:190 edits `a` in place, and if the second line_edit is cancelled no fetch runs. The header (lyrics.inc.c:182) then shows the new artist over the old results.

code_evident_bugs.title: Uninitialised field pointers in cover_fetch
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/lyrics.inc.c:103-108 declares `char *f[5]` and only requires split_tabs to return >=2, but then reads f[2], f[3] and f[4], which are uninitialised when a line has fewer fields (undefined behaviour, possible crash).

code_evident_bugs.title: Mini player / Now Playing cover not refreshed after saving a cover from Music menus
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/music.inc.c:1450 and 1468 call cover_search and then only mu_cover_forget(). They never call nu_npx_refresh() (which nowui.inc.c:1160 does), so npx keeps the cached 128 px cover until the track changes. mu_up (the upscaled hero cache, music.inc.c:677) can also keep the old image.

code_evident_bugs.title: Album covers silently missing under normal memory pressure; repeated hibywall respawns
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/music.inc.c:480-481: with MemAvailable below ~8 MB, lim<4096 makes it return -2 every time. If a decode fails with lim<10 MB it also returns -2 (music.inc.c:494-497), the slot is reset to state 0 (music.inc.c:573), and the next frame requests it again, so hibywall runs about once per second per visible album (CPU and audio risk). Once lim reaches 10 MB a failure writes a permanent .none marker, and that album shows a placeholder until its folder changes.

code_evident_bugs.title: Tag and cover writes to the currently playing file without any warning
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/tageditor.inc.c:1065-1068 checks te_playing() only for renames. ht_batch_kv (tageditor.inc.c:1076) and ht_set_cover (lyrics.inc.c:159) rewrite files that HiBy may have open. This could explain audio cuts or the player restarting.

code_evident_bugs.title: Open Music library not refreshed after tag edits
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/music.inc.c:1447-1448 runs tag_editor and returns without reloading ML or invalidating the pages. lib.tsv is only re-validated when the app opens (music.inc.c:259-297), so titles and search results stay stale.

code_evident_bugs.title: Volume keys not serviced during blocking animations
code_evident_bugs.evidence: Volume keys are read only inside read_pkt (hibyshell.c:619-626). mu_slide (music.inc.c:1297-1307), nu_sheet_anim (nowui.inc.c:681-701), nu_menu entry/exit (nowui.inc.c:1363-1423), nu_crossfade (nowui.inc.c:740-756), nu_toggle_lyrics and the open/close zooms never call it, so the pill reacts only after the animation. With read_pkt(…,0) (inertia, spinner) hud_step is skipped (hibyshell.c:629), so only hud_after_present moves the pill, at the cost of a second present per frame.

code_evident_bugs.title: Concurrent player key threads from rapid NP taps
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/nowui.inc.c:172-177 creates a detached thread per tap, and each runs pc_key with an 80 ms hold. Taps closer than 80 ms apart can interleave press and release events on the same device.

code_evident_bugs.title: 8-item context menus overlap the status bar
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/nowui.inc.c:1323 clamps cy0 to H-12-total. For 8 items total=442, so cy0=26, and the card (rows 26..90) is drawn over the bottom of the status bar.

code_evident_bugs.title: Bottom of 'Usar esta letra' in the standalone preview swallows taps
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/lyrics.inc.c:602 treats any touch with sy>=456 and 60<x<260 as a possible home swipe and `continue`s, but the button spans y 422..468 (lyrics.inc.c:593).

code_evident_bugs.title: Now Playing status bar loses coloured icons and updates only every 5 s
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/nowui.inc.c:339-343 converts the status bar to white-over-background using only the green channel as alpha, and nu_poll refreshes it every 5000 ms (nowui.inc.c:835). Music's mu_statusbar (music.inc.c:1208-1225) also turns icons grey, and an idle Music page does not re-present.

code_evident_bugs.title: Tag editor field rows and the action buttons below the fold for single songs
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/tageditor.inc.c:665-667: GAP 22 plus 8 fields x 40 px puts the cover/lyrics buttons at y 436..488, so they are partly off-screen until you scroll.

catalogs.notes:
I only read the source; I did not touch the device or change any file. Coordinates come from the layout code and assume scroll 0 and a 320x480 screen.

**Assumptions to keep in mind:**
- Rows near the bottom (y >= 420) sit under the 60 px mini player whenever something is loaded; scroll before tapping them.
- Context menu item positions depend on the row's screen y (ry) and the item count. The values given are for 8-item menus (card clamped to y=26) and 7-item menus on the album page (card at y=70).

**Missing features:** the Now Playing sheet has no shuffle, repeat, queue or scrubbing controls (nowui.inc.c:11-12). pc_seek_send exists in playctl but nothing calls it. The scrub test case only checks that dragging the bar does no harm.

**Out of scope here:** the volume-limit warning and the Control Center music tile belong to other areas. They are covered here only as Music-context combinations; their root causes are in hibyshell.c (vs_visible / vs_overlay, touches never reach HiBy while a ByOS app is in front) and cc.inc.c:724.

**Most likely code causes behind the user's reports in this area:**
- **Covers not found, and changing the search text does not help:** stale c<i>.jpg / thumb files from the previous search are reused (lyrics.inc.c:117); results are dropped when the artist is empty or different (hibynet.c:870, 925); covers are not generated under low memory (music.inc.c:480).
- **Glitches when leaving Music:** the unhandled -3 return from the search keyboard home gesture (music.inc.c:1785).
- **Play/pause icon not switching:** the optimistic flip is overwritten by the 1 s snapshot (music.inc.c:1718).
- **Audio cuts / player restarts:** tags and covers are written into the file HiBy has open, with no warning.

code_evident_bugs.title: Playing an audiobook that is already playing rebuilds the player list (audio cut + jump back)
code_evident_bugs.evidence: books_ab.inc.c:2205 and :2210 call ab_play() unconditionally; ab_play sends pc_list_send_pos (books_ab.inc.c:1719-1720), which runs play_index again in hibymod_disp.c:1376. The resume position comes from ab_<id>.pos, saved only every 20 s (books_ab.inc.c:1693), so playback restarts and jumps back up to 20 s. Matches 'audio cuts a bit, the player closes and reopens already working'.

code_evident_bugs.title: Now Playing opened from Books appears with no animation
code_evident_bugs.evidence: ab_open_player calls np_app_run(under, -1, -1) (books_ab.inc.c:1885); with ix<0 nowui.inc.c:1450-1459 skips the zoom and presents the full sheet in one frame. After an audiobook play the sheet just pops in, which reads as a glitch.

code_evident_bugs.title: Second play request while the player is busy is dropped, giving a 5 s timeout
code_evident_bugs.evidence: The H_SEC branch has no ab_play_id guard (books_ab.inc.c:2210), while H_MAIN has one (books_ab.inc.c:2199). pl_kick ignores an 'L' while pl_busy and writes no result (hibymod_disp.c:1382-1388), so ab_play_poll times out with 'El reproductor no respondió' (books_ab.inc.c:1738-1741).

code_evident_bugs.title: Resume position unit is unverified
code_evident_bugs.evidence: playctl.inc.c:16-17 says the pos= unit of 'L' is unverified. hibymod_disp.c:1376 passes it to play_index(idx, pos, 0x10002). If the unit is wrong, audiobooks resume at the wrong place or start at 0 and then seek.

code_evident_bugs.title: Reader ignores the top (Control Center) and edge gestures; a pull from the top edge closes the book
code_evident_bugs.evidence: bk_reader (books.inc.c:1023-1162) never calls back_zone or app_back_gesture, unlike the TOC (books.inc.c:958) and the library (books.inc.c:1310). A downward drag from y<48 sets moved=2 and runs the close-book animation (books.inc.c:1084-1086, 1111).

code_evident_bugs.title: Use-after-free risk in the TXT contents sheet
code_evident_bugs.evidence: bk_toc_build stores pointers e->title = bk_ttoc[i].title (books.inc.c:870). The pagination thread reallocs bk_ttoc every 64 headings (books.inc.c:534) while the sheet is open and bk_toc_render keeps reading those pointers every frame (books.inc.c:898). Possible garbage titles or a crash (sudden close).

code_evident_bugs.title: TXT contents entries duplicated after a size change during the first pagination
code_evident_bugs.evidence: In bk_pag_thread, first = !bk_ttoc_done is recomputed on restart (books.inc.c:555) without resetting bk_nttoc. bk_th_mark then appends the same headings again (books.inc.c:526-541).

code_evident_bugs.title: Covers that failed 3 times are never retried
code_evident_bugs.evidence: bk_meta_thread steps cov 3->4->5 and then sets 2 (generated) (books.inc.c:244). bk_index_apply only retries 3..5 (books.inc.c:173). hibyguard kills hibywall under memory pressure (hibyguard.c:184-191), so covers can be lost for good. Matches 'covers are often not found'.

code_evident_bugs.title: Truncated thumbnail cache file blocks that cover forever
code_evident_bugs.evidence: ab_img_load returns -1 when the size is not w*h*2 and caches nothing (books_ab.inc.c:207). ab_thumb_need returns 0 whenever the raw file exists (books_ab.inc.c:551), so the cover is never downloaded or converted again, and it stays missing across searches.

code_evident_bugs.title: hibywall failure on an existing JPG deletes the wrong file
code_evident_bugs.evidence: The direct-convert path in ab_thumb_need sets kind AJ_WALL without setting ab_jt.out (books_ab.inc.c:553-559). On failure ab_poll unlinks ab_jt.out, which still holds a previous job's output (books_ab.inc.c:1949), so the bad JPG stays and conversion keeps failing. Only the most recent failure gets a 60 s cooldown in store lists (books_ab.inc.c:567-581).

code_evident_bugs.title: Audiobook cover never generated again if hibywall failed in the worker
code_evident_bugs.evidence: abw_cover_raw ignores the result (books_abcore.inc.c:1301-1307). ab_enqueue only queues the cover when cover.jpg is missing (books_ab.inc.c:1754-1759), so a failed conversion leaves the generated cover forever.

code_evident_bugs.title: Download button flashes 'Reintentar descarga' just after tapping Descargar
code_evident_bugs.evidence: ab_worker_start returns once the intermediate process exits (books_ab.inc.c:62-72), before the grandchild writes abdl.pid (books_abcore.inc.c ab_worker_run). ab_enqueue then calls ab_ds_read (books_ab.inc.c:1780) and gets alive=0, and ab_render_book shows 'Reintentar descarga' (books_ab.inc.c:1286).

code_evident_bugs.title: UI can freeze while the cover thread runs hibywall
code_evident_bugs.evidence: bk_meta_join (books.inc.c:260) sets the stop flag but waits on pthread_join, while the thread may be inside waitpid on hibywall (books.inc.c:214). It is called when opening any book (books.inc.c:606), on every return to Biblioteca via bk_lib_scan (books.inc.c:1284, 267) and when deleting.

code_evident_bugs.title: Volume pill freezes during reader drags and animations
code_evident_bugs.evidence: hud_step runs only from read_pkt with timeout_ms>0 (hibyshell.c:629). Reader drag and pull loops use read_pkt(&p, 0) (books.inc.c:1096, 1120), and the slide, zoom and sheet loops never call read_pkt. Key events are not even read until the animation ends.

code_evident_bugs.title: HiBy volume-limit warning cannot be confirmed while inside Books
code_evident_bugs.evidence: While the shell captures the screen, all touches go to the Books loops (bk_reader, ab_run) and are never forwarded to HiBy. hud_key only handles the pill (hibyshell.c:1128-1139). Matches the report that the over-limit warning flickers and OK cannot be pressed.

code_evident_bugs.title: Mini player play/pause icon can flicker
code_evident_bugs.evidence: H_MINIPP flips ab_np.playing before the player changes state, then re-reads np_get 400 ms later (books_ab.inc.c:2181). A late state update flips the icon back and then forward again.

code_evident_bugs.title: Fallback scrub inflates chapters on every finger move
code_evident_bugs.evidence: Before pagination finishes, each move calls bk_get(tch) (books.inc.c:1070) and bk_frac/bk_chrome_draw call it again. With a 3-chapter cache, scrubbing a big EPUB inflates and paginates chapters synchronously, so it stutters.

code_evident_bugs.title: File I/O inside render loops
code_evident_bugs.evidence: ab_render_mine calls ab_is_paused (reads abdl.paused) for each downloading cell on every frame (books_ab.inc.c:1048). ab_render_dl does the same (books_ab.inc.c:1449). ab_render_book reads the .pos file twice per frame (books_ab.inc.c:1292, 1329), and frames repaint every 80 ms while downloading.

code_evident_bugs.title: Home gesture ignored while the themes sheet or menu popup is open
code_evident_bugs.evidence: bk_sheet (books.inc.c:832-846) and bk_menu (books.inc.c:766-781) do not check y>=456. A swipe from the bottom is treated as a tap in or outside the sheet.

code_evident_bugs.title: 'Empezar desde el principio' shows '1 %' instead of NUEVO
code_evident_bugs.evidence: The book menu sets pct=0 but keeps opened>0 (books.inc.c:687). The library then renders max(1, pct) % (books.inc.c:18 of bk_lib_render).

catalogs.notes:
I read the sources only; nothing ran on the device. Files read: src/books.inc.c in full, src/books_ab.inc.c in full, the worker and queue part of src/books_abcore.inc.c (1166-1362), and the related parts of playctl.inc.c, hibymod_disp.c (the 'L' play-list handler), syspop.inc.c, nowui.inc.c (np_app_run), cc.inc.c (own_top_gesture), gestures.inc.c (back zones), hibyguard.c (which helpers it kills) and hibyshell.c (read_pkt, present, the volume pill).

Coordinates come from the layout constants: AB_TABY=424, AB_HDR=92, AB_NAV=76, cover cells at BK_LIST_Y=92, theme sheet top0=244, menu card at (90..304, 304..396). A few are approximate because they depend on text length:
- the main button of a book's page (about y=244 for LibriVox, y=274 for Gutenberg; lower if the title wraps to 3-4 lines);
- the Populares/Novedades control, whose position depends on the width of the language name;
- the chapter rows, which sit below the description, so you scroll to reach them.

The reader has no bookmarks and no font-family choice: the Themes sheet has only text size and three themes. The user asked for these, so treat it as missing features, not a regression.

Several user reports in this area line up with code:
- Audiobook play glitch: Now Playing pops in without animation; tapping play on a book that is already playing re-sends the whole list; and the resume position unit has never been checked.
- Missing covers: covers that fail three times are never retried; a truncated thumbnail file blocks that cover permanently; and a failed hibywall conversion deletes the wrong file.

Two user reports are not caused by the Books code, but every Books screen triggers them, so they are tested here as combinations: the HiBy volume-limit warning (touches never reach HiBy) and the Control Center music widget.

Bluetooth and the status-bar Wi-Fi/Bluetooth icons belong to other modules. Books cases only check that they show up correctly.

The ADB tool tools/hiby.py can drive these cases with tap/hold/swipe/key:106,event3/key:105,event3/shot. Per the user's rules: blur network identifiers in screenshots, and don't open the browser on the device.

code_evident_bugs.title: Bluetooth list hides devices that have no resolved name
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/wireless.inc.c:984 only adds unpaired devices with `wv.devs[i].name[0]`. src/wireless_parse.inc.c:375-377 clears the name when it equals the address or the dashed alias. Headphones discovered before the remote-name request finishes (common with BR/EDR inquiry under load) are never shown, and there is no address fallback. This matches 'headphones never appear'.

code_evident_bugs.title: Bluetooth discovery restarts in a loop when bluez answers slowly
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/wireless.inc.c:643-646 restarts discovery if `WS.ad.discovering` is 0 six seconds after start. That flag is only updated by wl_bt_refresh, which takes 8-13 s or fails and keeps the previous state (wireless.inc.c:495-503). The stale 'not discovering' value triggers 'scan off' and 'scan on' every ~6 s, which can cancel the 10.24 s BR/EDR inquiry before the headphones answer.

code_evident_bugs.title: Discovery window is only 45 s and needs a pull to re-arm
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/wireless.inc.c:590, 636 and 1396 set `wl_disc_until = now + 45000`. Headphones put in pairing mode after 45 s are not found until the user pulls down, and the only hint is the small 'Desliza hacia abajo para buscar' row.

code_evident_bugs.title: Pairing and connecting bypass HiBy's sys_server, so there is no BT status icon and possibly no audio route
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/wireless.inc.c:596-617 pairs and connects with dbus-send directly and only writes /data/bt_lastused.txt (line 611). The player is never told through its own path, so the HiBy topbar (the only status bar, copied by ByOS in launcher.inc.c:675-694 and sysset rendering) may never show the BT glyph. Pairing also depends on HiBy's bt-agent being the default agent (`agent off` at line 536); if bt-agent is not running, Pair fails.

code_evident_bugs.title: Status bar icons thicken when HiBy repaints into a buffer that holds the shell image
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/hibymod_disp.c:946 copies the shell frame into HiBy's buffer, but the HiBy frame is only restored when the pan moves to a different buffer (line 948 condition, restore at 960-969). On same-buffer pans (st->same_pans), HiBy redraws its anti-aliased Wi-Fi glyph over already-blended pixels, so the edges thicken ('gets bigger'). The non-capture path also edits HiBy's own buffer in place (sb_fix at 951) and uses r[-1] (x=237) as the background sample (line 283), which smears whenever icon ink touches that column.

code_evident_bugs.title: EU high-volume warning is not handled in ByOS screens: OK cannot be pressed and the indicator flickers
code_evident_bugs.evidence: HiBy's vol_ask dialog is drawn only into fr1 while a ByOS screen is captured, and touches go to the shell, so OK is unreachable. No code anywhere handles vol_warn or vol_ask (grep finds only the config toggle). With vol_ui=HiBy, hibyshell.c:1164 ties the pill lifetime to vs_visible() grey sampling, so the indicator switches on and off as the dialogs alternate. With vol_ui=ByOS on HiBy screens, hud_frame does a 'C' capture and an 'R' release per burst (1085-1097), which also flickers.

code_evident_bugs.title: Rows in the bottom 24 px cannot be tapped
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/settings_app.inc.c:834-844 (and wireless.inc.c:1423) treat any touch-down at y>=456 as a home-gesture start and swallow it if it is not an upward swipe. At scroll 0, 'Batería y energía' (root, centre y=478), 'Puntos de página' (Home, y=474), 'Por inactividad' (General, y=488) and 'Filtro digital' (CC page, y=492) are visible but cannot be tapped.

code_evident_bugs.title: Digital filter change runs amixer synchronously in the UI thread
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/settings_app.inc.c:691-697: apply_filter calls amixer_filter, which spawns amixer twice with run_capture, from the UI loop. The comment at line 645 says amixer must never run in the UI. ssa_reset_sound (sysset.inc.c:377) does the same. The UI freezes, and the volume pill stalls during it.

code_evident_bugs.title: cfg_set calls sync() in the UI thread and may truncate config.json
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/settings_app.inc.c:667-684 reads at most 8191 bytes and writes back only n bytes, so a larger config.json is truncated. It then calls sync(), which can block for seconds on UBI flash. au_reboot is set even when the value is toggled back to the original.

code_evident_bugs.title: Filter label can be wrong right after boot
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/settings_app.inc.c:685-690: audio_sync maps au_filt_cur to an index using filt_vals(), which depends on au_filt_max learned asynchronously (audio_boot_th). If the index is computed with the 2-entry list and later shown with O_FILT8 (sysset.inc.c:521), index 1 shows 'Lento, fase lineal' instead of 'Híbrido, fase mínima'.

code_evident_bugs.title: Wallpaper picker has no status bar and no home or back gesture
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/settings.inc.c:158 `memcpy(dst, fr1, 0)` copies nothing (top 56 px are a solid colour). picker_run (170-226) only handles taps at y<56, so the bottom home swipe and the edge back do nothing; the only exit is 'Cerrar'. Applying runs hibywall synchronously (216) right after toast(), so the toast is not visible during the wait.

code_evident_bugs.title: Three independent caches for Wi-Fi/BT state
code_evident_bugs.evidence: Settings root values use ps_v[PS_WIFI]/ps_v[PS_BT] (sysset.inc.c:296-298), the Wireless pages use WS.wset/WS.ad.powered (wireless.inc.c:855-856), and the CC uses ccbt_on (ccbt.inc.c:8-21). Each refreshes on its own schedule, so switches can briefly disagree or flip back.

code_evident_bugs.title: Volume indicator switch may need a player restart but the page does not say so
code_evident_bugs.evidence: src/sysset.inc.c:506 ssa_volui rewrites HiBy's volume.dlg (hibyshell.c:1037-1061) without setting au_reboot. If HiBy caches the dialog layout, both indicators (or neither) show until restart.

catalogs.notes:
I read the code only and did not touch the device. Coordinates come from the layout constants: NAVH=64, so content starts at y=106; rows are 44 px; a section with a header adds 28 px and one without adds 14 px; the back button is at x<110, y<94; switches sit at x 241-292.

Rows that come after a footer depend on how many lines the translated footer takes (16 px per line). For those, take a screenshot and adjust before tapping.

Safety for automated runs:
- Do not confirm Wi-Fi off, Forget the current network, ADB mode changes, USB Storage, Line out (it sets volume to max), Reset Home, OTA/firmware installs or Reboot while the harness uses ADB over Wi-Fi. Test only their Cancel paths, unless ADB over USB is available.
- Blur SSIDs, IPs and MACs in every screenshot before publishing.

The Settings > Wi-Fi and Bluetooth rows open the Wireless pages through wireless_sub (SS_HAVE_WIRELESS), not the fallback pages in sysset.inc.c:433-451.

The EU warning threshold (34 for 3.5 mm, 28 for 4.4 mm) comes from docs/research_hidden_firmware.md:39.

dossiers.bug:
High-volume (EU) warning: when the volume ring goes past the recommended level (34 on 3.5 mm, 28 on 4.4 mm), HiBy's modal "Want to turn up the volume above the recommended level?" appears. The screen then flickers between that dialog and ByOS (home screen, volume pill, home bar), and tapping OK does nothing or lands somewhere else.

Where the warning comes from: it is HiBy's own dialog, not a ByOS one.
- HiBy's volume-key path calls 0x420b58, which compares the volume with warn_vol from /usr/resource/config.json (docs/research_hidden_firmware.md:119-150).
- It opens the "vol_ask" confirm dialog, using stock layout usr/resource/layout/theme3/dialog/confirm.dlg. The text is str/english/exception.ini:87.
- A second dialog, volume_long_time_high.dlg (prolonged exposure, 0x535de0, param 0x77), has the same layout plus a countdown text (docs/research_hidden_firmware.md:152, docs/research_settings_api.md:64).
- Both dialogs are full screen: a black 320x450 view starting at y=30. Cancel is at x 0-159, y 416-480 (colour 0x1c1c1e). OK is at x 160-319, y 416-480 (colour 0x009ff6).

ByOS has no idea a HiBy modal is open:
- It does not grab the volume keys (hibyshell.c:1831), so HiBy sees every ring step.
- To ByOS the modal is just "the player changed screen". The home screen, the volume pill, the home-bar overlay, home substitution and the edge gestures all keep running and take turns owning the panel and the touches.

root_causes.hypothesis: Main cause: ByOS does not recognise HiBy modal dialogs, so the screen and the touches bounce between ByOS and HiBy, and taps never reach OK. (1) On the ByOS home screen, ByOS keeps capturing the screen and every touch goes to the home screen's own handler. When HiBy draws the dialog underneath, the main loop sees a non-home frame and calls launcher_leave(), which sends 'R' (release the screen to HiBy). On the next loop pass the volume pill is still active, and hud_frame() sees a HiBy screen and sends 'C' (capture) again. When the pill times out, hud_end() sends 'R' and update_overlay() draws the home bar over the dialog's button row. With the ByOS pill (vol_ui=1), every further ring step repeats this C/R cycle. Users keep turning the ring because the volume is stuck at 34, so the cycle runs again and again. (2) With HiBy's indicator (vol_ui=0), vs_visible() keeps the ByOS home screen in front while HiBy's grey volume bar is still drawn. The home screen then covers the modal and eats every tap. The dock icons sit at y 392-448, under the OK/Cancel row (y 416-480), so a tap on OK launches a dock app. That app captures the screen and hides the modal again. (3) Inside any ByOS app the modal stays invisible in fr1 while HiBy blocks the volume. When the app exits, back_to_home() injects taps at (22,48) and back-swipes into the modal. When it fails, the release drops the user onto the bare dialog.
evidence: hibyshell.c:1831 and 1837-1842: volume keys are read but not grabbed, so HiBy gets every ring step and can raise the modal again

hibyshell.c:1846-1849: with launcher_on, every new HiBy frame runs `if (!is_home(fr1) && !vs_visible()) launcher_leave();`. The modal is treated as 'player changed screen'. While HiBy's grey volume bar is visible (vs_visible, hibyshell.c:1015-1018) the home screen stays in front of the modal
hibyshell.c:1891: `if (launcher_on && p.down && p.n) { launcher_touch(&p); ... continue; }`: every tap goes to the ByOS home screen, never to HiBy
launcher.inc.c:15-17 and 331-336: DOCK_Y = 480-18-84 = 378, dock icons at y 392-448. They overlap the modal's OK/Cancel row at y 416-480 (stock confirm.dlg: vg_confirm_yes x160 y386+30, w160 h64)
launcher.inc.c:865-875: launcher_leave() sends cmd('R')
hibyshell.c:1079-1094: hud_frame() sends cmd('C') to capture a HiBy screen when `!hud_cap && !st->capture && !st->held`, then shows fr1 plus the pill
hibyshell.c:1095-1097 and 1165-1171: hud_end() sends cmd('R'), then update_overlay() draws the home bar (hibyshell.c:1195, BAR_Y 469) over the modal's buttons

hibyshell.c:1128-1133: hud_key() returns early only when `!vol_ui && !st->capture`. On the home screen or in a ByOS app (capture=1), and on every HiBy screen with vol_ui=1, each ring step re-activates the pill
hibymod_disp.c:404-414 ('C' freezes the shown buffer) and 427-439 ('R' copies frames+fsize back): each C/R pair replaces the whole frame on the panel
hibyshell.c:498-511 back_to_home() and launcher_touch.inc.c:294: they inject tap(22,48) and a back-swipe into whatever HiBy shows, the modal included, when leaving an app or a failed launch
hibymod_disp.c:685-696 and hm_shared.h:35-36: the display library already logs every .dlg the player opens (st->vlog), but the shell never reads it, so there is no 'HiBy modal open' state anywhere

root_causes.hypothesis: Second loop between ByOS home and dialog, through home substitution. With the ByOS pill (vol_ui=1), the rewritten volume.dlg hides HiBy's grey bar, so nothing covers the home-screen signature while the volume changes. If HiBy redraws or re-creates its home frame between modal frames (dialog rebuilt on a ring step, open or close animation), home_substitute() pastes the ByOS home image into that frame and increments home_hits. The main loop then re-enters the home screen at once (launcher_enter_ex(1) sends 'C'). The next modal frame fails is_home and calls launcher_leave() ('R'). The result is home/modal/home at the ring's step rate, and taps during the home phase go to the dock.
evidence: hibymod_disp.c:150-178 and 953: home_substitute() runs on every pan outside capture and overwrites rows 30-479 of HiBy's own buffer when all signature points match

launcher.inc.c:165-171: the signature points are the top-row icons at y=GRID_TOP+14=60, the dock icons at y≈406 and the background at (6,348) and (314,318). y=60 is inside HiBy's grey volume capsule (VS_Y 30..68), which is why the comment at hibyshell.c:1848 says the volume dialog covers the signature
hibyshell.c:1037-1061 vol_ui_apply() and tools/make_payload.py:199-211: with vol_ui=1, every element of volume.dlg is set to "visible":"hide", so the capsule no longer breaks the signature
hibyshell.c:1854-1857: `launcher_enabled && !st->capture && !st->held && st->home_hits != home_hits_seen` triggers launcher_enter_ex(1) with no stillness check
hibyshell.c:1846-1848: the next non-home frame triggers launcher_leave() again

root_causes.hypothesis: The volume pill costs a lot of CPU and memory while it runs on a HiBy screen, which adds to the stutter. While hud_active, the main loop polls with a 0 ms timeout. Each pass, hud_frame() allocates a 300 KB full-frame buffer (hud_tmp), and lazy_release() at line 1887 frees it again because the release is not guarded by !hud_active. That means malloc/free (mmap/munmap plus about 75 page faults) of 300 KB per frame on a 57 MB device with no swap. dossiers.bug: Bluetooth under ByOS: headphones never appear in the list, or appear but never pair or connect. The page sometimes says "Bluetooth isn't responding" (WL_BT_NA, reported in handoff.md:24). Stock HiBy Bluetooth works on the same unit, with the same bluetoothd 5.54, bt-agent and bluealsa.

root_causes.hypothesis: H1. The device list depends on one huge GetManagedObjects dump done by forking dbus-send every 2 s, and that call times out under load. On the R3 II the dump takes 8-13 s or more, so the reply timeout trips. Each failure keeps the old snapshot. After 6 failures in a row the adapter is shown as missing, the list is emptied and the page says 'Bluetooth isn't responding'. The BT worker thread also sits blocked inside these calls, so it cannot manage discovery or reflect newly found headphones. hibybudsd makes it worse: it runs its own full GetManagedObjects on every InterfacesAdded, and every newly discovered device sends one. Stock sys_server never re-dumps: it keeps a GDBus ObjectManager client and gets incremental object-added signals.
evidence: src/wireless.inc.c:453-456: comment says the dump exceeded 96 KB in busy places; cap raised to 384 KB (WL_DBUS_CAP), so every refresh moves hundreds of KB through dbus-daemon and dbus-send on a single-core MIPS

root_causes.hypothesis: H2. Discovery is stopped and restarted in a loop, and it is capped at 45 s. The 'did not start' watchdog reads WS.ad.discovering, which is only updated by a successful refresh. When the refresh is slow or fails (H1), the snapshot from before the scan (discovering=0) stays. Then every ~6-14 s the code sends 'scan off/quit' and starts a new bluetoothctl. Each stop ends the BlueZ discovery session, so the BR/EDR inquiry (10.24 s cycles) never finishes cleanly and found devices become temporary again. On top of that, discovery only runs for 45 s after the page opens. Headphones put into pairing mode after that window are never searched for unless the user pulls to refresh.

The list keeps stale entries when refresh fails. wl_disc_stop() runs just before Pair, and BlueZ drops non-paired discovered devices shortly after discovery ends, so Device1.Pair can fail with UnknownObject or DoesNotExist. root_causes.hypothesis: H4. Discovery fails silently. bluetoothctl gets all its commands at once through a pipe, and its stdout and stderr go to /dev/null. Errors are never seen: 'No default controller available' (radio still coming up), 'Failed to start discovery: org.bluez.Error.NotReady/InProgress', 'Invalid command' on 'menu scan', or SetDiscoveryFilter errors. root_causes.hypothesis: H5. ByOS relies on HiBy's bt-agent for pairing but never checks or protects it. ByOS's resource guard sets oom_score_adj to -400..-900 for bluetoothd, bluealsa, dbus, sys_server, the player and the shell, and leaves bt-agent at 0. Under ByOS's memory pressure, bt-agent is the first system Bluetooth daemon the OOM killer would take. Without a default agent, BlueZ answers a legacy PIN request or an SSP confirmation from an outgoing Pair started by dbus-send (which has no agent) with AuthenticationRejected/Failed. Stock firmware is never under that memory pressure. 'agent off' in our bluetoothctl is harmless by itself.

root_causes.hypothesis: H6. The connect step treats harmless BlueZ answers as failures. Many headsets open A2DP by themselves right after bonding, so the immediate Device1.Connect returns org.bluez.Error.InProgress, AlreadyConnected or Failed 'br-connection-busy'. The code then shows 'No se pudo conectar' even though the device connects a moment later, and bt_lastused.txt is not written. dossiers.bug: The Wi-Fi icon in the status bar is cut, flickers, and is drawn wider: about 24 px at x 231-254 instead of 17 px at x 215. It happens on HiBy screens and on ByOS screens, because both copy rows 0-30 from HiBy's frame.

root_causes.hypothesis: Main cause: HiBy places the Wi-Fi icon itself, not at the x in topbar.view. It puts the icon left of where a right-aligned battery % would be (net.x = battery_icon.x - 2 - width_of_'NN%' - wifi_w). With 2 battery digits that is 279-2-29-17 = 231, so the icon covers x 231-247. That lands inside the block sb_fix() moves, columns [238, 276). sb_fix() treats the Wi-Fi arcs in columns 238-246 as battery digits. It shifts the right part of the icon 9 px right (to 247-256) and fills columns 238-246 with r[-1]. r[-1] is column 237, which is a Wi-Fi pixel, so each row of the icon gets stretched sideways. The result is one blob about 24 px wide starting at 231 (the 'bigger' icon), with a break at x=238 (the 'cut'). HiBy also draws its battery digits left-aligned at 238, which is on top of icon columns 238-247, so HiBy's own frame is already overlapped before sb_fix runs.
evidence: The numbers match exactly. Stock topbar.view (//wsl.localhost/Ubuntu/home/alber/hiby/rootfs/usr/resource/layout/theme3/topbar/topbar.view:97,105,107,117) has net x=238 w=20, nv_battery x=258 w=45, battery x=302. The same formula gives 302-2-(3*10+12)-20 = 238, which is exactly the stock net x. With ByOS widths (battery x=279, digit 9, % 11, wifi 17) it gives 279-2-29-17 = 231, which is exactly the observed start.

HiBy is already known to ignore a topbar.view x: theme/topbar.py:234-235 notes the player puts topbar_iv_output 'right after the volume digits, ignoring its x; seen on the device' (commit 5dbfb75). The layout checker at theme/topbar.py:277-295 assumes every icon sits at its static POS x, so it cannot catch this.

Generated layout: src/topbar_layout.h:2-4 gives TOPBAR_PCT_X 238, TOPBAR_PCT_W 38, TOPBAR_DW 9. theme/topbar.py:258-260 gives X_PCT=238 and X_NET=215. The Wi-Fi PNG is 17 px wide (theme/topbar.py:147-158). theme/work/.../theme3/topbar/topbar.view has topbar_iv_net x=215, but the observed icon is at 231.
src/hibymod_disp.c:265: k = (3 - sb_ndig) * TOPBAR_DW = 9 when the battery has 2 digits, so the shift only happens below 100%.

src/hibymod_disp.c:273-281: the 'idempotent' ink test only checks whether columns 238..238+k contain anything that differs from bg = r[-1] (line 277). Wi-Fi arcs there count as ink, so the test never stops the shift. bg is itself an icon pixel, so the test is unreliable anyway.

src/hibymod_disp.c:282-287: memmove(r + k, r, (38-k)*2) moves everything in [238, 276), Wi-Fi pixels included, and r[x] = bg fills the 9 vacated columns with column 237, a Wi-Fi pixel. This produces the horizontal smear that makes the icon look wider.

src/hibymod_disp.c:951: on HiBy's own screens (not capturing), sb_fix runs in place on HiBy's real buffer. HiBy later redraws only the Wi-Fi image view (on level changes) over the already-shifted block. The ink test passes again and the block is shifted again, so the copies left from earlier shifts creep right into the % and the battery: 'cuts out and gets bigger'. The sb_done hash (lines 267-268, 288) covers the Wi-Fi pixels too, so every change of Wi-Fi level defeats it.

root_causes.hypothesis: Why it flickers: the Wi-Fi x and the shift both depend on battery digits and timing, and the two display paths treat the block differently. In capture mode (ByOS screens), each pan copies HiBy's buffer to frames[1], applies sb_fix to that copy, and then writes the unshifted sb_raw back into the hidden buffer (restore). On HiBy screens the shift is done in place and builds up. Moving between shell and HiBy screens, Wi-Fi level updates, and the 2 s battery re-read (sb_ndig, lines 259-264) each change which version of the smeared or cut icon is shown. The x itself moves too: 222 at 100%, 231 at 10-99%, 240 below 10%.
evidence: src/hibymod_disp.c:940-944: capture path; sb_fix is applied to a fresh copy on every pan.
src/hibymod_disp.c:966-969: restore puts back sb_raw, the block as HiBy drew it, which already has Wi-Fi and digits overlapping.

src/hibymod_disp.c:259-264: sb_ndig is re-read every 2 s, so k switches between 0 and 9 as the battery crosses 100%.

root_causes.hypothesis: Secondary contributor: when HiBy pans the same buffer twice, restore is skipped, so HiBy's partial redraws land on the shell image that 'P' copied into that buffer. That image's status bar is already tinted and composited. The shell then reads it back from fr1 and composites it again. statusbar_tint() stops recognising a 'black bar with icons' (it needs 80% dark pixels) and compose_statusbar_on() treats the brightness of the tinted background as icon coverage. dossiers.bug: The Bluetooth icon never shows in the ByOS status bar, even while Bluetooth is on and headphones are paired or connected.

root_causes.hypothesis: H1 (main cause). ByOS never draws a Bluetooth icon itself. The whole status bar is HiBy's own drawing, and HiBy only lights its 'topbar_iv_bt' icon (switching to the 'bluetooth.png' image) when its own Bluetooth state says 'connected'. HiBy learns that only from a 'BT:CONNECT:OK' reply from sys_server (HiBy's system service) to a 'BT:CONNECT:<mac>' request that HiBy itself sent. ByOS connects headphones behind HiBy's back: it calls BlueZ (the Linux Bluetooth stack) directly over D-Bus with dbus-send. sys_server never gets a request from HiBy, so it never sends a reply, HiBy's state stays 'not connected' and the icon keeps its 'off' image, which ByOS made blank. The same gap means HiBy never moves its audio output to 'bluealsa:DEV=...', which matches the 'Bluetooth does not work, stock did' report. CompasOS avoids this by working out the icon from BlueZ and bluealsa itself.
